description: Write an author entry (for example today's menu) without republishing the page. Creates or replaces 1-20 entries in one list (collection) of an owned HTML page or site, each addressed by `key`; typically a list with `write: author`. Visitors' entries stay untouched.

key.description: Entry name: 1-128 letters, digits, _ . -, not starting with _

value.description: The entry's JSON value, typically an object

manageUrl.description: The page's private management link (https://brewpage.app/manage/...#k=...); stands in for namespace, id and ownerToken.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: set_page_data
title: Write author entries
